ops.title: Route .app-bundled helper programs through daemonkit's deployment package
ops.description: cookiesync's helper executable lives inside CookieSync.app/Contents/MacOS; staging a byte copy out of the bundle loses Info.plist, Resources, and bundle identity — exactly what an Aqua GUI helper needs for TCC/keychain and what AssociatedBundleIdentifiers attributes. daemonkit's exported deployment package (NewCandidatePlan + ApplyInstalledCandidate, codesign-verified canonical app install — the path cc-notes' internal/helperdeployment already uses) is the right home for .app-kind helpers; plain executables stage via daemonkit StableProgramFrom (v0.20.7). Until adopted, .app helpers keep versioned Caskroom paths in their plists and strand on every cask upgrade (daemonkit backlog 74be91d7). Found 2026-07-26 during the helper-plist fix wave (daemonkit fleet-stabilization task fc39f885).

ops.text: .app-kind helper Program resolves to a codesign-verified canonical install location that survives cask upgrades
cookiesync helper agent survives a cask upgrade without manual re-install
